# Security Guidelines - FAM MUSIC V.2

## Secret Management

### JWT Secret

The JWT secret is used to sign and verify authentication tokens in the WebSocket server.

**Requirements**:
- Minimum 64 characters in production
- Cryptographically random
- Never committed to version control
- Rotated periodically (every 90 days recommended)

**Generation**:
```bash
# Generate a secure JWT secret
openssl rand -base64 64
